label: Bible Study
prompt: And the peace of God, which passeth all _____, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verse: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
note: A peace that doesn't explain itself — it stands guard instead.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find _____ unto your souls.
verse: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
note: A yoke that gives rest instead of taking it — Jesus's equipment works backwards.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And David _____ before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.
verse: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.
note: The ark comes home and the king danced with all his might — dignity was not the priority.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a _____, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
verse: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
note: James's weather report on human life: morning mist, gone by breakfast — plan accordingly.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead _____.
verse: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
note: The whole 'fulness of the Godhead' dwells in him 'bodily' — a complete Christology in one adverb.
